headword: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}

definitions.explanation: A promotional offer allowing users to try a product or service for free for a limited time before committing to a paid subscription.

examples.japanese: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I signed up for the free trial.

examples.japanese: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}は1ヶ{月|げつ}です。
examples.english: The free trial is for one month.

examples.japanese: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}{期間|きかん}が{終|お}わったら{自動|じどう}で{課金|かきん}される。
examples.english: You'll be automatically charged when the free trial period ends.

notes:
{無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん} is commonly offered by subscription services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}に{申|もう}し{込|こ}む (to sign up for a free trial)
- {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}{期間|きかん} (free trial period)
- {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}キャンペーン (free trial campaign)

WATCH OUT:
- Many free trials require credit card registration.
- Auto-renewal ({自動|じどう}{更新|こうしん}) is often enabled by default.

RELATED WORDS:
- お{試|ため}し: trial, sample
- {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}: first-time only
- {解約|かいやく}: cancellation
